race.comment: BURNT ENDS (12) got off the mark in style here last time and has plenty to offer on the quick back-up. Gets in at the minimum and should prove a handful to hold out. Goes on top of THE BARBER (3) who made the perfect return at Rocky when making every post a winner. This is obviously tougher but he deserves his shot in town. COOL GENT (2) could land in a tricky spot from the inside draw if Stewart doesn't have switched on but does possess a strong turn of foot. Watch for him bursting through late. VOLCANIC RUSH (11) is still a maiden but looks to have his share of ability and should relish the extra 200m. Keeping safe.
